appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Positive Test Rate at Sentinel Sites'.
Y-axis scale: 5.5% to 8.0%, with gridlines at 0.5% intervals (e.g., 6.0%, 6.5%, 7.0%, 7.5%).
X-axis scale: 2017 to 2020, with tick marks for each year.
A single purple line connects data points for the years 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020.
Data point for 2017 is at approximately 5.5%.
Data point for 2018 is at approximately 6.5%.

printed_facts.fact: Reported window shown in the dashboard summary.

public_definitions: Review the sentinel-site trend dashboard and select the operational route that best reflects the full 2013-2020 pattern for positive test rate.

Use the displayed year-by-year positive-test-rate pattern across the entire available period to determine whether this record should be routed for sustained growth follow-up, continued monitoring of a more recent upswing, or decline-focused review.

Sentinel site trend routing decision: Route to continued monitoring for a more recent upward shift in positive test rate, Route to sustained growth follow-up for an across-period increase in positive test rate, Route to decline-focused review for a downward positive test rate pattern.
